_comment: Quote of the day. A quote whose date (YYYY-MM-DD, India time) matches today is shown; otherwise a published undated or past-dated quote is chosen deterministically by date. status: published | draft. Use null for anything not yet known.

meaning.en: Learning shines through humility. What we learn should show in how we act.
meaning.te: విద్య వినయంతోనే ప్రకాశిస్తుంది. నేర్చుకున్నది మన నడవడికలో కనిపించాలి.
